text:
linda (PeopleOps): quick ask — putting together a compact pre-boarding + week1 / 30-60-90 checklist for the new Product Manager starting Mon. can I share a one-pager we can use with hiring managers? :wave:
cecil (Hiring Manager): yes please. something that sets expectations for the first week (meet people, ship a tiny win), and a simple 30/60/90 that we can edit per role would be perfect.
samir (Eng Lead): can we include a short eng-specific ramp? like repo access, first PR walkthrough, pairing schedule. also prefer a line about recurring 1:1s with the manager (weekly) and a 30/60/90 sync cadence.
emma (IT): for pre-boarding we need these from the hiring manager: full legal name, preferred name, shipping address, laptop type preference, manager phone. once I have those I can kick off device imaging and Slack invite. typical lead time is 48 hrs for macbook staging.
linda (PeopleOps): thanks — i'll draft the one-pager here. keeping it minimal so managers will actually send it. plan: (1) pre-boarding checklist (2) day1 agenda (3) week1 daily rituals (4) 30/60/90 editable template (single slide). anyone want to add or remove?
cecil (Hiring Manager): add: who-to-cc for access (eng infra, data infra, security) and who to ping for immediate blockers. also add a short note on success criteria for week1 (e.g., set up env, attend onboarding, introduce to PM team).
samir (Eng Lead): add a mentor pairing note — suggest first 2 weeks pairing 3x/week for 1hr to get context. i'll volunteer maya as mentor if she's available.
emma (IT): FYI we have a short command for managers to request devices: `/device-request @it device:macbook-pro spec:M2 reason:onboarding` — i can add it to the doc. also tag `#it-requests` for expedited handling.
people-ops-bot: reminder created — "Onboard: PM - Monday" assigned to linda and emma. Due: in 2 days.
linda (PeopleOps): draft below (super short). please react if happy or suggest edits. this is meant to be copy-paste for hiring managers.
---
Pre-Boarding (to complete before Day 1):
- Manager: confirm shipping info + laptop request to IT
- Manager: invite new hire to key Slack channels (#product, team channel)
- PeopleOps: send welcome email with first week agenda + 1:1 calendar stub
- IT: provision account & device, add to SSO groups (eng, product)

Day 1 agenda (sample):
- 9:30am intro w/ manager (30m) — expectations, role scope
- 10:15am team intro + show-and-tell (30m)
- 11:15am IT & accounts check (15m)
- 1:00pm product context + roadmap overview (45m)
- 3:00pm buddy pairing session (60m)

Week1 rituals (goal = context + small win):
- daily 30m check-in with manager (first 3 days)
- pairing sessions with buddy (3x week)
- shadow cross-functional meetings to learn stakeholders
- small onboarding project (first PR or customer-issue writeup)

30 / 60 / 90 template (editable):
```
30 days: learn + connect — complete access, meet stakeholders, complete onboarding project
60 days: contribute — own a small area, ship at least one enhancement, start shaping priorities
90 days: deliver & scale — lead a cross-team effort, propose improvements to process or infra
```
---
cecil (Hiring Manager): love it. can you add a short checklist for managers on feedback cadence and a place to capture top 3 goals? maybe a table but keep it optional.
linda (PeopleOps): good call. i added a small section for "Top 3 onboarding goals" and a suggested feedback cadence (weekly 1:1 + 30/60/90 reviews).
samir (Eng Lead): i'll add an engineering ramp note: access to repo `redwood/core`, seed issue labeled `onboarding`, first PR target 2 weeks. also add a link to the internal dev setup guide: https://redwood.internal/dev-setup
emma (IT): i've requested device staging for Monday start. please confirm laptop model in the doc. if manager doesn't respond by EOD fri, i'll ship standard MacBook Pro.
linda (PeopleOps): final ask — cecil, can you paste the new hire's shipping address here once you confirm? i'll trigger the rest. also i can attach a calendar bundle for 1:1s and the 30/60/90 review slots (weekly for 12 weeks).
cecil (Hiring Manager): will do. thanks everyone. this one-pager should reduce last-minute chaos. :tada:
people-ops-bot: onboarding checklist updated — calendar bundle attached to the hire record.
